tests.command: ARGUS_RESEARCH_RAIL_ENABLED=false NUMBA_CACHE_DIR=<writable-temp> PYTHONPATH=<candidate>/src:<candidate> <project-venv>/bin/python -m pytest tests/agent_runtime/ tests/research/ -q --no-cov

environment_notes: A first collection attempt failed before tests ran because Numba could not create a VectorBT cache locator inside the shared read-only project virtual environment.
The completed run used a writable temporary NUMBA_CACHE_DIR without disabling JIT.

The worktree links a production-style .env with the research rail enabled. The full unit-test run explicitly set ARGUS_RESEARCH_RAIL_ENABLED=false to match CI's clean default; tests that exercise the enabled rail set it themselves.
